assignment: SHA256(protocol_id || prompt_family_id || edge_id || split_seed); the lowest 128-bit integer is compared with floor(2^128 * 0.5).
construction_use: Beam search and ordering selection use only construction-split transports.
validation_use: Loop closure and suite validity are recomputed on target-blind heldout transports.
run_instance_requirement: A run cannot evaluate G4 until the concrete prompt, edge, loop, and atlas universes plus this deterministic assignment are sealed.
